name: Limestone County, TX
findings: Limestone County has 63 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 20 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Limestone County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
44% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Limestone County list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 60% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 6 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 60% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
